title: Get the format reference
description: Returns the product's `FormatReference` from `formatReference(repoRoot)`: the meta-model with the product's extensions merged, and Lathe's checks with the product's own.

title: Get a record's history
description: `GET /api/history?id=<record ID>` (and `&skip=<n>` for older commits) answers with the commits that changed the record's rows in the data files, newest first, and the changes not committed yet. `lathe serve`, the app's Vite plugin and the desktop app (through `serve()`) all serve it.

title: Get the product's data
description: Returns the product's `SpecData`: the schema description, every stored table's rows as the data files hold them, and the checks' problems and coverage. One call returns everything; the client builds its index and does all navigation. When the fixture is served, the response carries `x-lathe-source: fixture`.

title: Write to the data
description: Takes `{ commands }`, one write, and applies it through the store's command layer as one transaction. Answers 200 with the changed rows, or 422 with the store's refusal and every reason; the data files change only on 200.
